correctness.rationale: For the combinatorial generator the four blocks give the rates 0, n−2, n, and 2(n−1). For adjacent points the signed row difference has coefficients α, β≥0 and γ≤0 after antisymmetrization. The bounds |a|,|b|≤1/2 and |c|≤1/2 are jointly saturated at (1/2,1/2,−1/2) when two generic indices exist. For n=3 they do not exist: c=−1−min(a,b) is the minimizing admissible generic value, and the objective is maximized at (1/2,1/2,−3/2). For same-side points the dual optimum is obtained at (1,−1); for deleted-matching points at (3/2,−1/2). All these witnesses satisfy every graph-edge constraint; the sign-based upper bounds match. Thus the three distances, the cancellation of e^(−nt), the exact adjacent Lip norm and its derivatives, and the gap 2(w−u)/3 for the six-cycle versus equality for n≥4 follow, including t=0. For n=4 all normalized pair classes tie. RESULT.md §§1–5 and the rational witness/finite enumeration code were inspected; the recorded checker output was not rerun or used as the all-time proof.
